title: Core realization from stagewise overlap comparison data
statement: Given the fixed overlap geometry and a family of prescribed comparison data at every stage, the canonical stage and apex equivalences admit coherent transition, base-change and object-pin data forming a PerfectHomObjectRealizationCore.

source.place: Tag 09RE, restriction and derived pullback composition comparisons in the first paragraph of the proof.

proof.text: Use the canonical cartesian square for the overlap and the inverse open-site equivalences to define the transition and base comparison. Restriction and composition coherence gives the natural comparison, and the supplied stagewise theta equations give the object pin for each Boolean object.

proof_origin.note: The cartesian composition and restriction calculation is isolated as an intermediate theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: canonical derived pullback comparison for two open restrictions
mathlib_searches.results: No exact theorem; only constituent categorical comparison APIs were found.

mathlib_searches.query: derived pullback composition and restriction comparison natural isomorphism
mathlib_searches.results: No single theorem; canonical composition API provides the constituent isomorphisms.
